row_guide: Band0 top: debug tiles, lily pads/foliage props, pond water, path samples (cobble/herringbone/gravel/dirt). Upper: grass–dirt and grass–water autotiles (shallow/deep/rocky), deep water, clay court, wood borders/piers, mounds. Mid: stone curbs around grass, dark picket fences (±stone base), low/tall brick walls, masonry walls. Mid-lower: spiked iron fences (grey/brown/orange bases), chain-link (straight/diagonal/damaged), ornate wood-iron fence, orange dirt paths, white-tile pools. Bottom band0: rock/plant scatter, guides, wood stubs, grass/dirt-top cliffs, pits, cobble floors, waterfall tops. Band1: grass–dirt/sand/pit transitions, rippled sand fills, sand–water beaches, sand plateau cliffs, rock strips, full waterfalls + drain pipe, modern slat fences (grey metal / light wood / dark wood) with front/side/post pieces.
